description: What the FastAPI end-to-end suite must notice: the Hub mis-classifying a project check, counting a failing run or a test run as evidence or a file edit, or write_file not creating folders.

mutations.name: F1-pytest-not-verify
mutations.what: python -m pytest no longer classed as a project check

mutations.name: F2-failing-run-counts
mutations.what: a failing run is counted as verification

mutations.name: F3-no-parent-folders
mutations.what: write_file does not create parent folders

mutations.name: F4-edits-count-runs
mutations.what: a test run is counted as a file edit
